notes: CDRH Quality System regulation (21 CFR 820) letter for an insulin-infusion-set manufacturer: unvalidated water-leak test method, complaint-handling failures (over 41,000 uninvestigated complaints, including a death), inadequate CAPAs, and Medical Device Reporting (21 CFR 803) failures for unreported serious-injury/malfunction events. Products include the Unomedical-branded infusion sets marketed under multiple distributor brand names plus the specific product families named in the CAPA/complaint narratives (Inset I/II, Varisoft, Extended Wear Infusion Set/EWIS, Inset Guard Ramp-Up, AutoSoft XC). No FEI is stated (only CMS case #719428). location_contains uses the Remote Regulatory Assessment facility location 'Reynosa, Tamaulipas' (Mexican state substituted for a US state abbreviation, per the Xinxiang/Henan precedent). violation_categories omits a distinct MDR/reporting tag since none exists in the allowed set; CGMP covers the Quality System Regulation violations.
